notes_for_editor: Thin record: one page, which reproduces the 1956 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description and carries a Removed status label. Searches found no build date, staffing history, fire record or post-removal description of the site. The record height (25.9 m) matches the survey's about 85 feet. The record's status gone agrees with the Removed label. Access is unknown and left out of facts. The Oates community page on Wikipedia was not used as a source.
